regions.merged_text: Fr. Solanus with H.J. Macey and Sister. H.J. had left school, for some weeks blind. Was brought to Monastery and enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n. reading on way home (Jan 2 - '34) : went back to school next day. Had been baptized with their father and two younger - Dec. 24th. Now received Ist Holy Communion. Thanks be to God for this and many similar favors reported.

regions.merged_text: You see Dear Owen, I'm getting to look like an old man. 20 years since you and I met, have made quite a change; but O! --- what will 20 yrs. more bring? Let us get ready as J. T. got ready. ·
